meta.name: Kraftwerk
meta.lineage: Ralf Hütter, Florian Schneider, Karl Bartos

identity.token: ZERO modulation + vocoder + motorik beat + machine precision
identity.two_second_test: Robotic precision, clean electronic, motorik pulse
identity.emotional_truth: Robot pop, industrial folk music, machine aesthetic

velocity_profile.description: Perfect consistency - 0% variation, every hit identical

timing.note: Machine precision - NO timing variation whatsoever

drum_patterns._format_note: 16-step patterns representing one bar of 16th notes. 1=hit, 0=rest. Steps 1,5,9,13 are downbeats (1,2,3,4).

kick.description: Steady 4-on-floor pulse - the relentless motorik drive
kick.source: Modified drum machine (likely Roland CR-78 or custom Kraftwerk electronics)
kick.character: Punchy, short, electronic - no sustain, immediate transient
kick.notes: 4-on-floor but without the disco energy - mechanical, inevitable

snare.description: Classic backbeat on 2 and 4 - robotic, unchanging
snare.source: Electronic snare - synthetic, not sampled acoustic
snare.character: Tight, controlled, no ring or overtones
snare.notes: Steps 5 and 13 are beats 2 and 4. Never varies.

hihat.description: Driving motorik 8th notes - the hypnotic pulse
hihat.character: Minimal attack/decay, identical each hit, trance-inducing repetition
hihat.notes: 8ths (main) or 16ths (more intense sections). All identical velocity.

electronic_perc.description: Optional electronic percussion - subtle synthetic accents
electronic_perc.character: Metallic, tuned percussion hits - sparse, accent function
electronic_perc.notes: Sparse accents. The '& of 4' pattern (step 15) creates subtle forward motion.

intro.description: Minimal - just hihat establishing the pulse, maybe pad/sequence

bridge.description: Slight variation with electronic percussion accents

breakdown.description: Reduced - kick drops out, snare sparse, hihat continues

outro.description: Gradual removal - drums fade leaving just the pulse

fill_patterns._note: Kraftwerk fills are MINIMAL - the machine doesn't show off

subtle_4_bar.description: Slight hihat density increase on bar 4

section_transition.description: Brief fill only at major section changes

anti_fill.description: The most Kraftwerk fill: complete dropout before section
anti_fill.effect: 1 beat of silence before new section (creates anticipation through absence)

production_notes.drum_machine: Custom modified electronics, possibly CR-78 derived
production_notes.mixing: Drums sit in the mix, not dominating - equal partners with synths
production_notes.eq: Clean, no warmth added - intentionally cold
production_notes.compression: Minimal - the machine has no dynamics to tame
production_notes.reverb: None to very short plate - space but not wash

philosophical_notes.motorik_essence: The drums are a MACHINE. They do not speed up when excited. They do not slow down when tired. They do not accent the interesting part. They simply continue.
philosophical_notes.kraftwerk_principle: Mensch-Maschine (Man-Machine): The human operates the machine, but the machine sets the pace. The drummer is replaced by a button.
philosophical_notes.anti_expression: Every fill, accent, or variation a human drummer would add is removed. The absence of personality IS the personality.
